name: netident/otel-enduser
description: Enriches OpenTelemetry SERVER spans with end-user identity (device id, session id, client address) for PHP apps using ext-opentelemetry auto-instrumentation.

suggest.ext-opentelemetry: Required at runtime to hook span creation via OpenTelemetry\Instrumentation\hook()
suggest.open-telemetry/sdk: Required at runtime so spans implement ReadableSpanInterface and can be enriched
